_comment: MiroFish-ready skeleton config for The Prompt Atlas marketing simulation. Drop this into backend/scripts/run_parallel_simulation.py via --config. The `agent_configs` array should be expanded by MiroFish's profile generator using personas.json; here we include a small worked example to illustrate the expected fields. Swap `event_config.initial_posts` per route in routes.yaml to run each marketing route.

event_config._comment: BASELINE run = no marketing intervention. Replace `initial_posts` with the route-specific intervention block (see routes.yaml) when running A1/A2/.../D3.

agent_configs._comment: Example seed agents. Replace this array with MiroFish-generated profiles seeded from campaigns/the-prompt-atlas/personas.json. The 8 examples below cover one agent per cohort so the file is usable as-is for a smoke test.
agent_configs.persona: Maya is a senior ML engineer at a mid-size AI startup. Late 20s. Skeptical of hype, hungry for tools that compress work. Active on X and Hacker News. Reads Ethan Mollick and Simon Willison.
Tenured associate professor of philosophy and AI ethics. Adopts books for courses that bridge humanities and ML and include assignable exercises. 45. Writes for both peers and the educated public.
Tech-culture journalist covering AI's impact on work and society. Pitches Wired, MIT Tech Review, Hard Fork. Triggers: a non-obvious angle and a quotable thesis. 35.
University reference librarian leading AI-literacy programming. Decision criteria: classroom-ready exercises, equity-aware framing, durable hardcover, OverDrive availability. 40.
Knowledge worker who reads 10 big-idea nonfiction books a year. Reads Mollick, Christian, Suleyman, Harari. Buys when at least two trusted signals converge. 38.
BookTok creator, 23, 180k followers. Decides in 15s on aesthetics + a quotable hook. Loves recursive visual metaphors and 'one prompt per chapter' formats that map to short video.
L&D lead at a 12,000-person company rolling out AI upskilling. Buys 50-250 copies if the book pairs with a workshop or speaker. Wants a humanistic frame to balance internal techno-optimism. 44.
AI-critical academic and labor organizer. Reads Bender, Gebru, Hao. Will publicly object to techno-utopian framings but engages seriously with humanistic / labor-aware framings. 41.

_route_intervention_examples._comment: Copy any one of the blocks below into event_config.initial_posts to simulate that route. Cadence and follow-up posts are scheduled via MiroFish's event scheduler; this file shows only the initial seed posts.

A1_podcast_tour.content: Just recorded a 90-min episode with the author of THE PROMPT ATLAS: KRONOS EDITION. Best framing of prompt engineering I've heard all year — 'recursive cartography for minds, not machines.' Drops Tuesday. https://promptatlas.dascient.org

A2_oped_campaign.content: My piece in @WIRED on why the next AI debate isn't about capability but about *meaning*. Inspired by Kronos Edition of The Prompt Atlas (DaScient Press).

B1_syllabus_toolkit.content: Sharing a free syllabus toolkit for AI-literacy courses, built around THE PROMPT ATLAS. 14 chapters, one prompt-engineering exercise each. Open-access PDFs of two sample chapters: https://promptatlas.dascient.org #AcademicTwitter
